text:
maria: quick heads up — opened PR #4127 to update console observability examples. cost/latency breakdown section still uses old metric name `token_cost_usd` which now errors in the new metrics v2 schema. also the trace hook example 404s when you click the embed link :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
chris: ack. can you paste the failing link? i can patch the redirect in docs-site if it's just a bad slug
maria: sure — it points to https://docs.redwood.ai/console/obsv/tracing-hook-embed (404). PR has the file: docs/console/observability/cost_breakdown.md
chris: ok that slug got renamed in the site refactor. i'll add a redirect and update the link in the PR. on the metric name — should we prefer `token_cost` or `cost_per_token`? dev-systems changed to `token_cost` last week
alex: +1 for `token_cost`. it's what the telemetry pipeline emits. also worth adding a small note about units (USD per 1k tokens) to avoid confusion in the console widget
sam: small thought — the trace hook snippet in the PR uses this block:
```js
const trace = traceHook({
  service: 'console',
  key: process.env.TRACE_KEY,
});
// sends to /api/v1/trace
```
but our runtime expects `/v2/traces` now. we should either shim the endpoint or update the snippet
maria: good catch. i'd rather update the snippet to match runtime v2 and call it out in the migration note. i'll push a commit to the PR after chris adds the redirect
docs-bot: build triggered for PR #4127 — preview available at https://deploy-preview-4127--docs.redwood.ai
chris: preview looks fine after redirect patch. one nit: cost widget screenshot shows old legend order (latency then cost). UX asked for cost-first in the redesign. can you regenerate the screenshot, maria?
maria: will regenerate. any preference on sample data values? want realistic but small numbers for screenshots
alex: use 12ms, 28ms p95 for latency, cost per 1k tokens = $0.35, tokens per request = ~450. makes the table readable
sam: after snippet and screenshot updates, can we add a short QA checklist to the PR description? things to confirm: link 200, example snippet runs locally, metric name consistent across docs and dashboard presets
maria: yep will add checklist and tag @eng-platform for final signoff. target to land today if no surprises :thumbsup:
chris: thanks — i'll follow up on redirects and LGTM after screenshot + checklist
maria: updated PR: changed `token_cost_usd` -> `token_cost`, updated trace snippet to `/v2/traces`, added migration note and screenshot regen. checklist added and tagged eng-platform. leaving for final reviews.
